Subject: Private CP SSO/SCIM — getting started

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're starting to scope the private control plane deployment and need to confirm how Redwood handles identity and role provisioning for an on-prem/VPC Private CP. A few things we need to validate up front:

- Can Redwood accept SAML assertions for login and map SAML attributes to internal RBAC roles? We need to restrict local admin access to a small set of users.
- Does Private CP support SCIM group provisioning for automated role assignment? What attributes (group externalId, displayName, members) do you expect?
- Any compliance constraints (audit logs, retention) we should be aware of for customer-managed control planes?

We're preparing an IdP metadata export and a list of groups, but it'd help to have a mapping template and a short runbook for provisioning. Can you share the template and a recommended staged rollout plan?

Goal: complete mapping and a smoke-test window the week of 5/24.

Thanks,
Sara Young
Directory & Identity Lead
Cobalt Bank

Hi Sara — great to meet you.

Short answers up front: yes to both SAML->RBAC mapping and SCIM group provisioning; we surface audit logs for the private control plane and can configure retention to meet most compliance needs. I'll attach a mapping template and a short provisioning playbook.

What we'll need from your side to make the mapping concrete:
- IdP metadata (SAML): metadata XML, and example SAML response with attribute names for a few users
- SCIM: example group object (JSON) from your IdP and whether you use group.externalId or group.displayName as the canonical key
- List of initial admin principals (emails) that should be granted cluster-admin and private-admin roles during cutover

Recommended staged rollout (high-level):
1) Off-network dry-run: configure Redwood Private CP in staging VPC with your IdP metadata; enable SAML login + SCIM sync but do not auto-assign roles (dry-run mode).
2) Role mapping review: iterate on mapping.csv with your IAM team (we'll share template).
3) Limited pilot: enable SCIM->role assignment for a small set of users/groups (admin + 2 app owners).
4) Full cutover: allowlist control plane endpoints, schedule 2-hour maintenance window for role binding and final sync, validate audit trails.

I'll attach a mapping template (CSV) and the provisioning playbook. Mina will lead the staging infra test; Vivek will handle the role mapping rules and policy constraints. Kimberly will coordinate compliance/audit config.

I'll send the attachments in a follow-up email so you can drop in your IdP examples.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Aditya/Sara — a couple of technical questions from our engineering team before we populate the mapping template:

1) SCIM patch semantics: do you expect the IdP to send group membership as full group objects (PUT) or diffs (PATCH)? Our Okta instance will send PATCH for group members.
2) When mapping SCIM groups to Redwood roles, can we use group.externalId as the canonical key? We prefer not to rely on displayName as those change.
3) SAML attributes: we'd like to send a multi-valued attribute called 'roles' (array) and also 'department' and 'employeeType'. Will Redwood accept multi-valued attributes and map them to multiple RBAC roles?

Also — please confirm whether Private CP supports SP-initiated SSO and if session length can be adjusted from the CP side.

Sample SAML assertion snippet (redacted):
-----BEGIN SAML-----
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="roles">
    <AttributeValue>corp_admin</AttributeValue>
    <AttributeValue>data_owner</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
-----END SAML-----

Thanks,
Cobalt IT Ops

Thanks for the details — answers inline below. Attaching: saml-scim-mapping-template.csv and privcp-scim-provisioning-playbook.md (see attachments).

1) SCIM semantics: we support both PATCH and PUT semantics; for Okta PATCH is fine. Our sync engine will accept incremental updates and reconcile on a periodic full-sync window.

2) canonical key: yes, prefer group.externalId. We'll match on externalId and fall back to displayName only if externalId is missing. Please provide externalId whenever possible.

3) multi-valued SAML attributes: supported. We will map each AttributeValue to role assignments. Example mapping rule: if SAML.roles contains 'corp_admin' => map to role 'private-admin' in CP. We also support combined mappings (SAML.roles + department) to limit elevation.

SP-initiated SSO: supported. Session lifetime: configurable per Private CP instance; we can align with your corporate SSO policy but suggest a default session TTL of 8 hours for interactive sessions. API tokens have separate TTLs.

Staged rollout notes (from playbook):
- Step 0: exchange IdP metadata and SCIM base URL + token.
- Step 1: configure SAML and set assertion consumer URL to the Private CP FQDN.
- Step 2: enable SCIM with read-only mode (no writes) and run a dry-sync.
- Step 3: review mapping.csv together and run a role-sim report (we'll run simulated role assignments and export a CSV of who would gain which roles).
- Step 4: pilot group assignment for 3 groups.
- Step 5: final allowlist update, enable write mode, record audit baseline.

Network note: for Private CP we require allowlisting of control plane Egress/Ingress IPs for SCIM callbacks and SAML endpoints. I'll attach the IP ranges and a minimal firewall rule set.

Action items (owners):
- Cobalt: share IdP metadata + sample SCIM group JSON; provide initial admin list (Sara).
- Mina: spin up staging Private CP and coordinate with Cobalt for test window.
- Vivek: prepare mapping rules and run role-sim report once we have sample attributes.
- Kimberly: advise on audit retention settings and any compliance documentation the customer needs.

I've attached the mapping template and the provisioning playbook to this message. Let us know an available 2-hour window the week of 5/24 for the pilot.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
